# Third-party material / 第三方材料

The root MIT license applies to Gold Miner's own code and documentation. It does
not relicense external README/issue excerpts, search snapshots, generated translations
of third-party text, or external dependencies. Their original sources and terms
remain applicable. Source URLs, versions and dates are preserved in experiments/
and docs/research/; an unknown source license is not an MIT grant.

本仓库 experiments/ 中的 README、issue 引文和 GitHub 搜索快照，以及
 docs/research/ 的外部引用，按各自来源保留权利。历史 gtx 输出是外部文本的译文，
不因根目录 MIT 而获得新的再分发授权。缓存默认为本地使用；公共译文/发现包的
来源许可仍须逐条核对，无许可或不明许可不得作为可公开共享条目。

The extension distribution contains Gold Miner code and localization strings;
it bundles no Playwright, browser executable, external README text or model library.
Playwright is a development-only test dependency (Apache-2.0 upstream); Chromium
is installed by CI and is not included in the extension archive.

License text reference: https://opensource.org/license/mit
Decision: docs/decisions/0003-license.md (2026-10-02).
